description: Configure an additional calculation mode. This command allows the user to specify that the model is using calculation modes that either require extra resources or are restricted by the current license. The model configure command can be given at any stage of an analysis, but it must be given before the calculation mode (model solve or model cycle) can be invoked. Calculation modes include cfd, thermal, mechanical, and plugins; 7.0 adds dynamic, creep, fluid, energy, and cluster.

6.0: Live 6.00 enum: cfd thermal mechanical plugins.
7.0: Must be given BEFORE model solve or model cycle can be invoked
Can be given at any stage of an analysis
Configures calculation modes that require extra resources or license restrictions
CFD mode enables fluid-particle coupling simulations
Once configured, the mode remains active for the model
May affect available memory and computational resources
9.0: Live 9.7 enum: the fluid option is configured via fluid-explicit / fluid-flow / fluid-implicit; axisymmetry and plugins are not live on 9.7.
